openGraph.title: RRE: Early-Stage Venture Capital Partner
openGraph.description: RRE is a boutique venture capital firm with 30 years of experience, backing bold early-stage founders across diverse sectors. We provide deep expertise, AI-driven insights, and committed partnerships to help companies build and persevere for the long term.
